hooks.command:
bun run "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/validate-bash-command.js"
code=$?
if [ "$code" = "0" ] || [ "$code" = "2" ]; then exit "$code"; fi
mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.blackhole/hook-events" 2>/dev/null
worktree="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
jq -n \
  --arg recorded_at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
  --arg hook "validate-bash-command" \
  --arg code "$code" \
  --arg worktree "$worktree" \
  '{version: 1, recorded_at: $recorded_at, hook: $hook, tool: "Bash", decision: "allow", tier: "error", pattern_id: "hook-exec-failure", reason: ("validator process exited " + $code + " before producing a decision"), worktree: (if $worktree == "" then null else $worktree end), detail: ("process exit code " + $code)}' \
  > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.blackhole/hook-events/hook-exec-error-$(date +%s%N).json" 2>/dev/null
echo "[blackhole-hook] validate-bash-command: validator process exited $code before producing a decision — call allowed (fail-open); see .blackhole/hook-events/" >&2
exit 0

bun run "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/validate-file-changes.js"
code=$?
if [ "$code" = "0" ] || [ "$code" = "2" ]; then exit "$code"; fi
mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.blackhole/hook-events" 2>/dev/null
worktree="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
jq -n \
  --arg recorded_at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
  --arg hook "validate-file-changes" \
  --arg code "$code" \
  --arg worktree "$worktree" \
  '{version: 1, recorded_at: $recorded_at, hook: $hook, tool: null, decision: "allow", tier: "error", pattern_id: "hook-exec-failure", reason: ("validator process exited " + $code + " before producing a decision"), worktree: (if $worktree == "" then null else $worktree end), detail: ("process exit code " + $code)}' \
  > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.blackhole/hook-events/hook-exec-error-$(date +%s%N).json" 2>/dev/null
echo "[blackhole-hook] validate-file-changes: validator process exited $code before producing a decision — call allowed (fail-open); see .blackhole/hook-events/" >&2
exit 0
